+# The following two instructions need too many registers on x86. We could
+# spill or do some cheeky stuff potentially but it's likely not worth the

+#ifndef JS_CODEGEN_X86

+# Okay this is a confusing name, but essentially, the above ops load/store a
+# slot of an object using the PropertyIndex associated with the *current* key
+# for the iterator. The below op uses the PropertyIndex associated with the
+# key indexed by `index`, rather than the current one.
+- name: LoadSlotByIteratorIndexIndexed

+    iterator: Object
+    index: Int32
+  result_type: Value
+  alias_set: custom
+  generate_lir: true
+  lir_temps: 2
+
+- name: StoreSlotByIteratorIndexIndexed

+    iterator: Object
+    index: Int32
+    value: Value
+  alias_set: custom
+  generate_lir: true
+  lir_temps: 2
+#endif
+
 # Load the private value expando from a DOM proxy. The target is stored in the
 # proxy object's private slot.
 # This is either an UndefinedValue (no expando), ObjectValue (the expando
 # object), or PrivateValue(ExpandoAndGeneration*).
 - name: LoadDOMExpandoValue

fix_commit.message: Bug 2003589 - Only enumerate own properties in Object.keys ObjToIterator r=iain
fix_commit.author: alexical

findings.title: Object.keys iteration enters the indexed-slot JIT fast path with unchecked Proxy side effects
findings.message: This newly added LoadIteratorElement branch lets Object.keys iteration use the iterator-indices optimization. For property loads it emits an indexed slot access based on the iterator's cached indices. The earlier iterator cache path can still enumerate/reuse prototype properties, including a Proxy trap that runs script. The reporter's debug-shell input trips the restricted JIT arbitrary-code assertion; a maintainer explains how a mutating trap can invalidate a reused array bounds check.

location.description: New indexed slot load for an Object.keys iterator element

related_locations.description: Existing cache lookup and iterator reuse without an own-only distinction

findings.suggestion: Use own-properties-only iterators for Object.keys and prevent reuse across enumeration scopes; do not apply the indexed fast path across Proxy side effects.

ground_truth.root_cause: The new iterator-index fast path assumes Object.keys iteration has no surprising prototype side effects, while the existing iterator cache and enumeration path do not enforce an own-properties-only iterator.
